Maria (Docs): Quick sync — Legal sent back comments on the SOC2 "data access review" section. I drafted a short paragraph + two small code snippets (audit log JSON + SDK export). Can folks glance before I open a docs PR? :eyes:

Ajay (Security): Thanks — can you call out the difference between "retention period" and "service-level TTL"? We need to be explicit about what we delete vs. what we truncate from caches. Also add a note about tenant-scoped audit events and KMS key rotation references.

Maria (Docs): Yup. Current draft below (super short). Thoughts on tone/legality?

Maria (Docs): ```json
{
  "event_type": "auth.token.verify",
  "tenant_id": "acct_1234",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-21T16:12:09Z",
  "meta": { "ip": "1.2.3.4" },
  "retention_days": 90
}
```

Maria (Docs): And a tiny SDK example for export in case customers ask:```python
# pseudo
client.audit.export(tenant='acct_1234', since='2026-01-01')
```

Leo (Legal): Short note: prefer "retention period" over "retention_days" in prose, but the JSON example is fine as-is for engineers. Also change any "may retain" language to "will retain for <period> unless otherwise requested" only where we have contractual obligation. Otherwise keep permissive wording.

Carol (Eng): From an implementation POV: add a sentence that audit exports are sampled for high-volume tenants and point to the Dedicated/Private behavior (cache vs persistent store). Also link to the export endpoint in the SDK docs: https://github.internal/redwood/inference/docs/security/audit-logs.md (placeholder).

Ajay (Security): Suggest small addition: "Audit logs are encrypted at rest using customer-managed keys where configured (KMS/HSM). Key rotation does not affect existing wrapped keys; admins should see rotation guide." Shortlink to rotation doc would be helpful.

Maria (Docs): I'll (a) change wording to "retention period" in the human-readable text, (b) add a one-line KMS note, (c) add a one-sentence callout about sampling for heavy tenants and Dedicated/Private differences, and (d) include both the JSON example and a Python + Ruby snippet.

Maria (Docs): Draft PR I will open in ~30m: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 (WIP) — leaving as draft until Legal + Security okay.

ops-bot: PR created by maria/docs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 (draft) :white_check_mark:

Ajay (Security): I'll review in a bit. Quick note: can you add a sentence that retention settings are tenant-configurable subject to contract? We still need the default behavior spelled out (90 days).

Leo (Legal): Will take a look after lunch. If we change "may" -> "will" we should gate on contract/matrix. I'll annotate the PR with suggested phrasing.

Carol (Eng): If you want a concrete code example for Ruby export, use:```ruby
# pseudo
client.audit.export(tenant: 'acct_1234', since: '2026-01-01')
```

Maria (Docs): Perfect. I'll push updates and tag you all. Who should I @ for final approval?

Ajay (Security): @Ajay (Security) and @Leo (Legal) for signoff, @Carol (Eng) for technical accuracy. I'll give a security thumbs-up once the KMS sentence is in. :+1:

Leo (Legal): Same. I'll resolve wording comments in the PR.

Maria (Docs): Thanks all — will update now and mark as ready for review in ~2h. :tada:
